page.layout: One page, a title page. Centred, in large capitals: FIDEI / MOSIS / AMYRALDI; / CIRCA ERRORES / ARMINIANORVM / DECLARATIO:. Below, a fleuron ornament and handwritten marks. Then the imprint, centred: SALMVRII, / Ex Typographiâ Ioh. Lesnerii, / Ad Insigne Libri Aurei. A rule, then the date M. DC. XLVI.
page.notes: Manuscript shelfmarks (A3 51, N.D.i. 1254 on a label), pencilled marks and the fleuron ornament are not transcribed. The final I of FIDEI is partly covered by a dark blot, but it is legible. The printed V in capitals has been changed to U per the u/v rule: ARMINIANORUM, SALMURII. No other doubtful readings.
